dimensions.note: Delta review for 2026.10.22.1 (hygiene cards #435/#436). The four credentials-sensitive-field findings (accessKeyIdFingerprint, secretFingerprint, deliveredTo.accessKeyIdKey, deliveredTo.secretAccessKeyKey) are now accepted inline with reasons, as the 2026.09.23.2 review already concluded: two 12-hex SHA-256 prefixes and two vault key paths, none of them secret material. The prior ISSUE is carried unchanged and not re-tested: delivery depends on context.vaultService.put/get, which is undocumented for extensions; create's preflight fails closed if it disappears.

Delta review for 2026.10.22.1 (hygiene cards #435/#436). Carried from the 2026.09.23.2 review; code for this dimension unchanged since (git log), and not re-reviewed in this delta. Every method logs entry and completion with structured placeholders. Rollback logs at warn; a failed rollback logs a ROLLBACK FAILED line naming the orphaned key id. No secret in any log line (tested).

Delta review for 2026.10.22.1 (hygiene cards #435/#436). Carried from the 2026.09.23.2 review; code for this dimension unchanged since (git log), and not re-reviewed in this delta. All preflight (target set, vault registered, slot available) throws before any mutating AWS call. Delivery failure and read-back mismatch roll the new key back before rethrowing with vault, item and cause. Rollback's catch is narrowed to NoSuchEntityException; anything else is surfaced. deactivate and delete read state back and throw if AWS returned 200 without effect.

Delta review for 2026.10.22.1 (hygiene cards #435/#436). Carried from the 2026.09.23.2 review; code for this dimension unchanged since (git log), and not re-reviewed in this delta. 15 unit tests with an injected fake IAM client and fake vault, no network permission: preflight ordering (zero AWS calls when vault missing), slot cap, happy-path delivery and fingerprints, secret absent from resources and logs, rollback on failed put and on read-back mismatch, delete refusing an Active key, deactivate->delete, delete of an unknown key, record carry-forward, inventory refresh, and the valid-target check. The fake writeResource now enforces swamp's per-execution instance-name uniqueness.

Delta review for 2026.10.22.1 (hygiene cards #435/#436). Carried from the 2026.09.23.2 review; code for this dimension unchanged since (git log), and not re-reviewed in this delta. create is inherently non-idempotent (each call mints a new secret); re-running is guarded by the one-key refusal unless allowSecond, and the AWS two-key cap is enforced before calling AWS. Interruption after mint and before delivery is handled by rollback; if rollback itself fails the orphaned id is logged. delete of an already-gone key is a no-op.

Delta review for 2026.10.22.1 (hygiene cards #435/#436). Carried from the 2026.09.23.2 review; code for this dimension unchanged since (git log), and not re-reviewed in this delta. 2026.09.23.1 shipped a collision this dimension exists to catch: create wrote key/current AND inventory/current in one execution, which swamp rejects ('Duplicate data instance name'), failing the run AFTER the key was minted and delivered. The test fake now enforces per-execution instance-name uniqueness; negative control with the old name fails 3 tests with the production error.
